directions.value: As a dietary supplement, adults take two (2) capsules daily. For best results, take with 6-8 oz (177-236ml) of water or as directed by a healthcare professional.

protocol.value: Take 2 capsules daily. Use as part of a consistent digestive support routine. If you are immunocompromised, seriously ill, pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or managing a medical condition, consult a healthcare professional before use.

safety.value: Genesis contains apple cider vinegar powder, prebiotic inulin, DigeZyme®, and Lactobacillus acidophilus LA85. Probiotic products may not be appropriate for everyone. Consult a healthcare professional before use if you are immunocompromised, seriously ill, pregnant, nursing, taking medication, managing a medical condition, or preparing for surgery.
